Mods that don't have a source/author link at the bottom are my own (except for some mods)

en.title: If the mod doesn't work
steps: Create a folder named dota_test in steamapps\common\dota 2 beta\game\
Place the required mod inside it
Add this to launch options: -language test

steps.text: If everything works after that, the issue was in the installation process, check the folder with your language and reinstall the mods.
If the problem persists, the issue lies within the mod itself.
When combining mods using VPKMerge, display issues may occur - try installing the buggy mod separately from the combined ones

If you don't see the emblems, try entering this command r_draw_selected_ring 1 in the game console, and also make sure you are not using the Misc Optimization mod in Minify (but this applies to standard emblems)

en.title: Recommended method
steps: Place video next to Changer.exe (I advise you to use 1920x1080, extensions: mp4, avi, mkv, mov, wmv, flv, webm)
Run <fcode>Changer.exe</fcode> and wait for the end (the longer the video, the longer it takes to process)
Press 1 - to replace full background, 2 - for the current patch/event (may not work).

en.title: If you need a picture
steps: Put an image (jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, gif) next to <fcode>Changer.exe</fcode>
Run <fcode>Changer.exe</fcode> and wait for it to finish

en.title: Manual Method
steps: Find or make a video in webm format (1920x1080 & 5-10sec recommended)
You can use online-video-cutter.com to create a video (e.g. crop to 16:9)
If it's heavy, you can compress it here: ezgif.com/video-compressor
Rename it to zxc.webm and place it next to Changer.exe
Press 1 - to replace full background, 2 - for the current patch/event (may not work).

Запустите <fcode>Changer.exe</fcode> и дождитесь окончания (чем длинее видос, тем дольше он обрабатывает его)
Нажмите 1 - для замены всего фона, 2 - под текущий патч/ивент (может не работать)

ru.title: Если нужна фотка

en.title: Using Convert Tool (Recommended)
steps: Put video in <fcode>Convert</fcode> folder (I advise you to use 1920x1080, extensions: mp4, avi, mkv, mov, wmv, flv. it won't work if you put zxc.webm there)
Run <fcode>./Convert</fcode> and wait for the end (the longer the video, the longer it takes to process)
It will move the created video to pak33_dir/zxc/, you only need to run ./Create

en.title: If you need a picture
steps: Put the image (jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, gif) in the <fcode>Convert</fcode> folder
Make Convert executable: chmod +x Convert and wait for it to finish
It will move the created video to pak33_dir/zxc/, you only need to run ./Create
